old_value: {"id":"fedistract-xod2","title":"Duplicate follow rows created on follow","description":"smallhold creates duplicate rows in the follows table when following a remote account. The follow action inserts two rows with the same persona_id and followee_remote_id. Likely the follow handler runs twice (once on Follow send, once on Accept receive) without checking for existing row. Fix: add UNIQUE constraint or INSERT OR IGNORE.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"mark@wolfssl.com","created_at":"2026-07-20T13:27:19.748529064Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-07-20T13:27:19.748529064Z"}

new_value: Fixed: root cause was SQLite UNIQUE constraint not enforcing uniqueness when columns are NULL. Added partial unique indexes (WHERE NOT NULL). Migration dedups existing rows.
